batch_patterns: All 13 products were created within 12 seconds on 2025-11-15 21:17 (27 catalog-wide), which points to one bulk import. Flavour siblings were re-added as separate simples on 18-19 Nov.
21 catalog image files contain '-sabores-<flavour>'. This shows a deleted variable 'Sabores' parent was flattened into simple products, which explains the orphaned IDs and media.

Duplicate SKUs exist although WooCommerce normally blocks them (REF-MLK-LT-250 x6, SNK-BAT-OST-ORI-30G x5, BSC-PPR-LT-47G x4, BSC-ARR-ORC-ORI-129G x3, REF-SAC-LT-238 x3, BLN-CHP-LT-CHC x2). This suggests the importer or direct database writes bypassed the uniqueness check. Another 59 products have no SKU.

Older listings share one 3-sentence ChatGPT template ('X oferece/proporciona... ideal para... Feito com... de alta qualidade... Invista/Escolha... qualidade superior, versatilidade e valor agregado'; 37 products). It is copied verbatim across flavours and names flavours of other products.
Newer rewrites (70, 259) switch to emoji plus '✅' checklists, pipe-stuffed titles with the store name, and short_description identical to description.

No food listing has a nutrition table, only 'Cerca de X kcal'. Allergen, gluten and lactose statements are missing or contradicted (70 claims 'Sem Glúten' while listing wheat flour). No importer ID, shelf life or Portuguese-label info appears anywhere.
Health and nutrient claims contradict the listings' own data: 'Zero Açúcar' with added sugar (64, 66), 'baixa caloria' at 500 kcal (69), 'entrega saúde' on soda (67).
Attributes are free-text custom text, not global pa_ attributes, so they cannot be filtered or used for variations. Size, brand and flavour are duplicated as tags instead.
Brand taxonomy mixes product line and manufacturer (Cantata+Lotte, Choco Pie+Lotte, Tok+Orion); toys use 'Genérico'; later products (800+) have no brand at all.

Weight and dimensions come from templates: every can is 0.28 kg and 5x5x13 cm, every snack bag 15x10x5 cm, and plush toys share copies. Choco Pie 6-unit boxes are set to 0.05 kg and 8x5x5 cm, so the Correios quotes are wrong.
All 103 products have empty image alt text; 12 of 13 in this batch are out of stock and the only in-stock item (70) has the worst data.
Plush attributes are identical across 135-142, with 'Antialérgico' claims, a 'Bebê e Infantil' category although rated 3+, and no INMETRO certification info.
SKU schemes are inconsistent and usually omit the flavour code (CAF-CNT-LT-GEL-230 vs CAF-GEL-CNT-LT-230); price formats mix 14.9 and 14.99.

All 13 descriptions follow one ChatGPT template: '[O/A Nome] proporciona/oferece/entrega X que Y, perfeito/ideal para Z que buscam W'. Then 'Feito com ... de alta qualidade' and 'se destaca/sobressai pela'. Then 'Invista/Escolha ... qualidade superior ... valor agregado ... indispensável/essencial'. These come from the 2025-11-15 bulk import; no emojis in this batch.
Short descriptions only paraphrase the first sentence of the description and add no facts.
Every product has exactly one image, and its alt text is empty.

Image file names such as 'sabores-morango', 'sabores-queijo' and 'sabores-maionese' show that multi-flavour listings were split into simple products. The splits kept a shared SKU (REF-SAC-LT-238, SNK-BAT-OST-ORI-30G) and a shared text that names other flavours (for example 'como kimchi').

Food data is placeholder-level. 'Ingredientes Principais' holds 3 generic items and calories are given as 'Cerca de X kcal por pacote'. There is no nutrition table, full ingredient list, importer, origin, shelf life or Portuguese-label info on any food item.
False or implied low-calorie claims ('baixa caloria', 'sem excessos calóricos', 'prazer sem culpa') appear on snacks of 467-526 kcal/100g, well above the IN 75/2020 limit of 40 kcal/100g.
Gluten and lactose wording does not comply. 'Pode conter glúten' is used instead of 'contém/não contém glúten' (Lei 10.674/2003), and 'Contém/Pode conter leite' appears without a lactose statement.

Snack shipping data is a placeholder: 15x10x5 cm with weight equal to net content. Later duplicate listings of the same items (864, 871, 952, 954) use 0.1-0.2 kg and 5x5x5 to 5x5x10, so Correios quotes are inconsistent.
The brand taxonomy mixes maker and product line (Orion+O'star, Orion+Tok, Lotte+Sac Sac, Lotte+Chum-Churum). Koony has no Orion brand in 147 but does in 871, and the plush toys use 'Genérico'.
Tags repeat title tokens (size, brand, flavour, 'Coreano') instead of using attributes. Flavour tags are often missing.
Several snack lines (O'Star, Marine Boy, probably Tok) appear to be Orion Vietnam products sold as 'Coreano'. The origin must be checked against the physical labels.
Plush toys have no INMETRO information, make unproven 'antialérgico/hipoalergênico' claims and carry a 3+ age rating while filed under 'Bebê e Infantil'.
